name: com.lib.loopsdk.ui.feature_landing_home.presentation.LandingHomeActivity
description: The Loop Loyalty SDK opens this dashboard when a user enters the loyalty program. It loads points, coupons, earning tasks, and games, with links to offers, scratch cards, quizzes, and spin-the-wheel games.
disableEffect: Users lose access to the Loop Loyalty dashboard and its linked reward and game entry points.
